caption: A symbolic base with an integer order expands to the product
A symbolic order comes back as [[Pochhammer]]
A complex base and order, through $\Gamma(a+n)/\Gamma(a)$, where native [[Pochhammer]] gives NaN
A negative order gives the reciprocal: $(5)_{-2} = \frac{1}{4 \cdot 3}$
A non-positive integer base with $|a| < n$ picks up a zero factor: $(-3)(-2)(-1)(0)$
At a pole of $\Gamma(a)$ with a non-integer order, $1/\Gamma(a) = 0$ makes the value 0
